title: SpaceX Delivered Fantastic News for Qualcomm Stock Investors
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc covers SpaceX selecting Qualcomm's Dragon Wing cellular infrastructure platform to power Starlink Mobile's nationwide terrestrial 5G network, news that lifted the shares 2.4%. SpaceX aims to turn Starlink into a major US mobile carrier, and the multi-year agreement ramps deployment from next year, laying the foundation for an AI-native 6G network, which he sees as a future catalyst alongside Qualcomm's data-centre entry next year. He has not put the deal into his discounted cash flow model because the terms and financial implications were not disclosed, but says revisions are likely to be higher. Even without it, Qualcomm looks significantly undervalued: his fair value is $282 against a $169 market price, and the forward P/E of 13 is near the lowest in several years. The headwind is smartphones, with unit sales struggling in 2026 and likely into 2027, though higher average selling prices and more components per phone, driven by AI features and rising memory costs, should offset some of that. He owns the stock, ranks it a buy with relatively high conviction, and is interested in adding more. Call: QCOM BUY reiterated at $169, fair value $282.
